text: This submission on the Delegation Schedule is to satisfy the annual requirements of Article 4 of the Financial By-law No. 2-18 that is effective January 1, 2025. Under the Financial By-law, the Delegation Schedule shall be submitted to the Board of Governors for approval at the last meeting of the calendar year.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the Delegation Schedule, attached as Appendix A to the report (November 28, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, prepared pursuant to Article 4 of Financial By-law No. 2-18, to be effective January 1, 2025.
